name: Echigoya Mankichi
source:
The head of the Echigoya Group, descended from wealthy merchants of the Edo period. And the organizer of the F○lin' Pic.

He loves oral sex so much he says, “Intercourse without a shakuhachi is nothing but mere friction.”

The secret shakuhachi banquets, said to have been held until the Edo period before being suppressed by the Meiji government.

He is a passionate man who used his full financial power to build an underground service area within the Oral Pleasure Dome, reviving them.

“This time, I aim for Cannes with a movie called ‘Shakubaka Diary’!”

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916184540/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/feralym/chara.html] archived official site[/url]]
